brief: The 6-tool indie dev stack — from idea to deploy in a weekend.

slots.tagline: The operating system for your indie project, from roadmap to launch checklist.
slots.f1Body: Centralize every spec, user story, and decision in one living workspace.
slots.f2Body: Track features across sprints with drag-and-drop simplicity and speed.
slots.f3Body: Generate outlines and summarize notes without ever leaving the page.

slots.tagline: Design responsive interfaces and prototype interactions before writing a single line of code.
slots.f1Body: Build flexible components that adapt to any screen size instantly.
slots.f2Body: Hand off inspect-ready CSS and assets directly to your editor.
slots.f3Body: Validate user flows and UX without building a real frontend first.

slots.tagline: An AI-native editor that turns natural language into production-grade TypeScript and React.
slots.f1Body: Accept multi-line suggestions that understand your entire codebase context.
slots.f2Body: Refactor functions, fix bugs, and scaffold features with simple prompts.
slots.f3Body: Generate files, write tests, and wire APIs across your project automatically.

slots.tagline: Open-source Firebase alternative giving you Postgres, auth, and edge functions in minutes.
slots.f1Body: Query relational data with full SQL power and row-level security.
slots.f2Body: Add OAuth, email magic links, and user management without custom servers.
slots.f3Body: Deploy TypeScript handlers close to users for low-latency API responses.

slots.tagline: Ship Next.js apps to the edge with zero-config CI, previews, and automatic scaling.
slots.f1Body: Push to main and watch your site build, test, and go live.
slots.f2Body: Share every pull request with a unique staging link for feedback.
slots.f3Body: Cache content across regions for sub-100 millisecond loads worldwide.

slots.tagline: Accept subscriptions and one-time payments with developer-friendly APIs and hosted checkout.
slots.f1Body: Drop in a prebuilt payment flow that works on every device.
slots.f2Body: Bill customers weekly, monthly, or annually with automated invoicing and reminders.
slots.f3Body: Sync payment events to your database and grant access in real time.

slots.ctaBody: Build your indie stack and go from idea to live product in 48 hours.
